## What this changes

(One or two sentences: the problem and the fix, or the feature.)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` has no errors and `npm test` passes
- [ ] I looked at the change on screen (PC first; phone and tablet only if the change touches their layout)
- [ ] The code is mine, or comes from a source whose licence is compatible with GPL-3.0, and I say where
- [ ] No new dependency, or I explain why it is needed
- [ ] No personal data in the code, tests or fixtures
